subject: english
textbook: 沪教版（五四制）2024新教材（牛津上海版）
skills: 家庭成员词汇：mum / dad / sister / brother / family / me
表达爱（I love my ... / I love my family.）
keySentences: This is my mum / dad / sister / brother.
pdf: ../pdf/2026上海一年级英语上册第六单元测试卷_沪教版2024.pdf

sections.title: Listen and circle. 听一听，圈出听到的图片
Look and match. 看图，把家庭成员和单词连起来
Read and choose. 读一读，选出最合适的句子
sections.answers: 1 This is my mum. 2 This is my dad. 3 I love my family. 4 This is me.

sections.title: Look and choose. 看"家庭照"，圈出正确表达
Speak and show. 说一说，介绍你的家人
sections.answers: 能用 This is my ... 介绍至少一位家人，并能说 I love my family. 即可。

sections.title: Listen and number. 听一听，给图片标上1-4
Choose and fill. 选择合适的单词填空
Complete the family talk. 选择句子补全"家庭介绍"
Think and choose. 想一想，选择合适的表达
sections.answers: 1A This is my brother. 2A I love my mum. 3A This is my family. 4A This is me.

sections.title: Mini-project. My family photo 我的家庭照
sections.answers: 能用 This is my family. / This is my ... / I love my ... 中至少两种表达介绍即可。

usageNotes: 每题听力读两遍。本卷不提前扩展 grandpa / grandma / uncle / aunt 等非本单元核心词汇。
